reasoning_content:
The changelog has been filtered (git.commit.id has been resolved to 239d434...). Next, I'll run Liquibase exactly as specified in the guide:

```
$LIQUIBASE_HOME/liquibase
      --driver=org.postgresql.Driver \
      --classpath=/liquibase/xplan-database-scripts.jar:./org/postgresql/postgresql/42.7.3/postgresql-42.7.3.jar \
      --search-path=/liquibase/xplan-database-scripts \
      --changelog-file=changelog_xplandb.yaml \
      --url=$XPLAN_JDBC_URL \
      --username=$XPLAN_DB_INIT_USER \
      --password=$XPLAN_DB_INIT_PASSWORD \
      update \
      -Dxplan.db.user=$XPLAN_DB_USER \
      -Dxplan.srid=$XPLAN_SERVICES_DEFAULT_CRS_SRID \
      -Dxplan.defaultCrs=$XPLAN_SERVICES_DEFAULT_CRS
```

Note: the guide uses the classpath `/liquibase/xplan-database-scripts.jar`, and additionally uses the relative path `./org/postgresql/postgresql/42.7.3/postgresql-42.7.3.jar`. I placed the postgresql driver at /opt/org/postgresql/postgresql/42.7.3/postgresql-42.7.3.jar. So I should run from /opt so that `./org/postgresql/...` resolves.

The search-path is `/liquibase/xplan-database-scripts` — hmm, this is the folder containing the Liquibase changelog files. Liquibase's search-path can point to a directory, and a jar file can also be included in the classpath. I'll use the following:
- --classpath=/opt/liquibase/xplan-database-scripts.jar:./org/postgresql/postgresql/42.7.3/postgresql-42.7.3.jar
- --search-path=/opt/liquibase/xplan-database-scripts (it would also be fine to point it at an extracted directory, or a jar path would work too)

Actually, the search-path should point to the place where the changelog is. The jar is on the classpath, so Liquibase can find `changelog_xplandb.yaml` inside the jar. Let's give it a try.

JDBC URL: jdbc:postgresql://localhost:5432/xplanbox
username: initxplanbox
password: initxplanbox
-Dxplan.db.user=xplanbox
-Dxplan.srid=25832
-Dxplan.defaultCrs=EPSG:25832

action.command:
cd /opt && cp /workspace/xplan-database/xplan-database-scripts/target/xplan-database-scripts-9.4-SNAPSHOT.jar /opt/liquibase/xplan-database-scripts.jar
export LIQUIBASE_HOME=/opt/liquibase-5.0.4
timeout 300 $LIQUIBASE_HOME/liquibase \
  --driver=org.postgresql.Driver \
  --classpath=/opt/liquibase/xplan-database-scripts.jar:./org/postgresql/postgresql/42.7.3/postgresql-42.7.3.jar \
  --search-path=/opt/liquibase/xplan-database-scripts \
  --changelog-file=changelog_xplandb.yaml \
  --url=jdbc:postgresql://localhost:5432/xplanbox \
  --username=initxplanbox \
  --password=initxplanbox \
  update \
  -Dxplan.db.user=xplanbox \
  -Dxplan.srid=25832 \
  -Dxplan.defaultCrs=EPSG:25832 2>&1 | tail -12; echo "LIQUIBASE EXIT: $?"
